name: Sunken Temple: the Sanctum dragons appear only after the Avatar of Hakkar and Jammal'an die
contract: On Ascension the four Sanctum dragons (Morphaz 5719, Weaver 5720, Dreamscythe 5721, Hazzas 5722) appear only once
the Avatar of Hakkar 8443 and Jammal'an the Prophet 5710 are dead. instance_sunken_temple hides the dragons
(invisible, passive, not selectable and immune to players) until both of those Eranikus wardens are killed, then
releases them. The hero stands beside Weaver's spawn (creature guid 239021, -458.84/127.7/-90.75);
nearby_creature_can_attack uses Player::IsValidAttackTarget, so it reports 0 while the dragon is held back and 1
once it is released. The Avatar and Jammal'an are summoned in the hero's instance and cast Suicide (7) on
themselves; any death of those entries counts as a warden kill. The hero is a level 60 human with a health
fixture, so the released dragons cannot kill them. Weaver and Dreamscythe spawn in phase 2 and their SmartAI
moves them to phase 1 on load, so the hero joins phases 1 and 2 to see the real spawns wherever they are; a
scenario in the normal world phase runs exclusively.

steps.label: Let the character finish logging in
The hero enters Sunken Temple beside Weaver and Dreamscythe
CONTROL: the hero is inside Sunken Temple
The hero sees the normal world phase and phase 2, where the real dragons spawn
CONTROL: Weaver's spawn is loaded beside the hero
Weaver cannot be attacked while the Avatar of Hakkar and Jammal'an live
Summon the Avatar of Hakkar in the instance
the Avatar of Hakkar casts Suicide (7) on itself
CONTROL: the Avatar of Hakkar dies
Weaver still cannot be attacked while Jammal'an lives
Summon Jammal'an the Prophet in the instance
Weaver can be attacked once the Avatar of Hakkar and Jammal'an are dead
